verdict.rationale: Antigravity's settings docs mention a Telemetry toggle to enable/disable sharing interaction logs 'to improve models,' which is the only evidence addressing training-data opt-out; there's no further detail on scope, default state, or enterprise data-processing guarantees. Missing for 10: independent verification the toggle actually excludes data from training, clarity on default setting, and any enterprise/DPA-level documentation of data usage.
